theorems.name: Submission.euclidean_slab_inter_closedBall_volume_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (e c : Rn m) (ε R : ℝ), ‖e‖ = 1 → 0 ≤ ε → 0 ≤ R → volume {v : Rn m | ‖v - c‖ ≤ R ∧ |inner ℝ e (v - c)| ≤ ε} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ε * (2 * R) ^ (m - 1))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
